items.snippet: Hello, BookApplications, I have a slightly unrelated question. I know a number of you are using public domain items to make experimental ebook applications. I started mine using ebooks from the Internet Archive, Gutenberg, Hathi Trust, and a few other places. This is partially because they are free.
